title: Senior Manager, People Operations Strategy and Programs
searchText: Senior Manager, People Operations Strategy and Programs Rubrik Job Board Senior Manager, People Operations Strategy & Programs The Role We are seeking a high-impact Senior Manager, People Operations Strategy & Programs, a true 'strategic operator' and Subject Matter Expert (SME) who will serve as the engine behind the People Operations function within our People organization . Reporting to the Global Head of People Operations, you will manage one direct report and serve as the lead Portfolio Manager and primary Transformation Lead, driving strategic resolution across our most complex cross-functional initiatives. This is an opportunity to dive deep into the technical core of HR processes to solve immediate bottlenecks today, while architecting a modern, automated, and AI-enhanced roadmap for tomorrow. Key Responsibilities Roadmap Management & Team Advisory Global Roadmap Ownership: Define, manage, and evolve the People Ops strategic roadmap. You will sequence initiatives and ensure the team is focused on high-ROI work. Functional Advisor: Serve as a day-to-day resource and SME for the People Ops team, troubleshooting complex issues, providing project guidance, and ensuring cross-functional alignment. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with People COEs, IT, Finance, Legal and others to represent People Ops priorities in project steering committees, ensuring our operational needs are integrated into broader company initiatives. Operational Governance: Lead the Quarterly Business Review (QBR) process to track team velocity, project health, SLAs (Service Level Agreements), and ticket volume reduction, ensuring data-driven decisions. Process Engineering & Modernization "The Fixer" Mentality: Conduct deep dives into friction-heavy processes. You will re-engineer these for scalability, moving the team away from "manual debt." AI & Automation Integration: Lead the practical application of AI and automation to eliminate repetitive tasks. This includes leading the architecture and implementation of our Jira-based, 24x5, tiered service delivery model , automating document generation, enhancing self-service via AI-powered knowledge bases, and simplifying data synthesis. TA Operations Excellence: Partner with Talent Acquisition to audit the "Recruiter to Onboarding" handoff. You will optimize TA workflows, ensuring seamless data flow between Greenhouse and Workday to eliminate manual data entry and improve candidate experience. Contingent Worker Program Evolution: Lead the modernization of our Contingent Worker program. You will refine the end-to-end lifecycle, from vendor management and onboarding to offboarding ensuring global compliance, better cost visibility, and automated provisioning. Execution & Change Management High-Stakes Project Lead: Serve as the hands-on lead for "must-win" initiatives (e.g., People Ops lead in TA infrastructure modernization, AI readiness, Workday improvements, simplification of our processes or global policy overhauls). Methodology & Standards: Establish the "gold standard" for project management, including Project Charters, rigorous UAT (User Acceptance Testing) protocols, and centralized SOP libraries. Modern Change Management: Develop communication and training loops that ensure new programs and tools are adopted seamlessly by employees and managers globally. Qualifications 8-10+ years of Agile Portfolio & Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, multi-quarter portfolios with an agile and nimble approach. Expert-level skills in formal P3M methodologies (Program, Project, and Portfolio Management) used to drive high-accountability and accelerated execution in a high-growth, global technology company. People Operations Domain Expertise: Significant background in People Operations (HR Shared Services, HRIS, Talent Acquisition, or Contingent Workforce) with a deep understanding of the employee lifecycle, global HR processes, and operational governance (e.g., SLAs). AI Fluency: Expertise in the Google Workspace ecosystem and Claude Cowork, with a strong aptitude for applying Google Gemini, Canvas, and NotebookLM to drive functional efficiency and data synthesis. Global Acumen & Compliance Fluency: Proven track record of managing projects across multiple geographies, including familiarity with international EORs, global payroll cycles, and deep knowledge of how to operationalize global compliance programs. The "Player-Coach" Edge: You are equally comfortable building a strategic roadmap for the Global Head of People Ops as you are rolling up your sleeves to audit a spreadsheet or troubleshoot a system logic error. Ecosystem Proficiency (Preferred): Hands-on experience with key HR systems like Workday, Greenhouse, or Jira is highly preferred. Fluency in Project Management tools (e.g., Asana) is a plus, along with familiarity with Managed Service Providers (MSP), Vendor Management Systems (VMS), and TA tech stacks Work from Our Palo alto office 3 days a week. #LI-AD1 The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $180,600 — $271,000 USD Join Us in Securing the World's Data Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com Inclusion @ Rubrik At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture: Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at hr@rubrik.com if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.
